key_lines: Cadet Estimator & Project Coordinator — Commercial Waterproofing

We are seeking a Cadet Estimator & Project Coordinator to support our commercial estimating function. The role is structured as a cadetship: you will begin on measured take-offs and bills of quantities under direct supervision, and progress toward preparing and defending complete tender submissions. It also carries genuine involvement in project documentation, procurement and site coordination, so you understand how the work you price is delivered.
Prior waterproofing experience is not required. Numerical ability, attention to detail and a willingness to learn the technical side are.
If you're part-way through any of the following — apply. You do not need to have finished it.

- A university degree in construction management, quantity surveying, civil or structural engineering, architecture, property or building surveying — including a first- or second-year student looking for industry experience alongside study, or someone who has paused a degree and wants to return to it while working.
- A Certificate IV, Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building and Construction.
- A trade qualification in waterproofing or a related trade.
- Any related qualification you're about to start, or have finished and now need the site and commercial experience to go with.

We'll work around lecture, class and assessment commitments, put you on the kind of live projects your coursework keeps referring to, and support you toward the licensing and industry training that follows.
- Prepare tender submissions, qualifications, exclusions and alternative system proposals.
- Attend site when required for measure-ups, pre-start walk-throughs and progress checks.
- A construction-related qualification — trade certificate, diploma or university degree — completed, in progress, or about to start.
